changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION landvault_plot_has_conflict_history(p_plot_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM listing_conflicts WHERE conflict_type = 'PLOT_OVERLAP' AND (left_entity_id = p_plot_id OR right_entity_id = p_plot_id) ); $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION landvault_plot_has_conflict_history(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_plot_has_conflict_history(uuid) TO ${appDbUsername};
